description: Creates or edits an AI receptionist. The account owner needs Business. It speaks with the caller and does not transfer the live conversation to a person.

voice.description: Voice the receptionist speaks with: one of alloy, ash, ballad, cedar, coral, echo, marin, sage, shimmer, verse (default marin), or a custom voice id made in the Widely app, which starts with voice_. Any other value is rejected.

name: upsert_receptionist
title: Set up an AI receptionist
